description.narrative: (Egypt): The Strengthening Egypt's Family Planning Program (SEFPP) supports the GOE's Family Planning and Reproductive Health (FP/RH) program and improves the quality of family planning services in the public and private sectors. .Using FY 2021 funds, SEFPP will expand and scale up successful voluntary family planning interventions and respond to the needs of the Ministry of Health and Population (MOHP). The activity will expand the availability of contraception services, train nurses to provide hormonal contraceptive methods (task-sharing), and launch E-Learning courses for providers. It will also refurbish and provide equipment for MOHP/FP training centers, family planning clinics and mobile clinics to improve access to family planning services in underserved areas. Additionally, the program will increase the participation of NGO and private sector partners to expand quality family planning services and leverage commercial sector resources for family planning. .
